title: Leeroy Jenkins
blurb: In 2005 a World of Warcraft guild spent several minutes calmly calculating a 32.33 per cent repeating chance of survival, at which point Leeroy — who had been away getting food — charged into Upper Blackrock Spire screaming his own name. The wipe was total. The video became one of the internet's founding legends and a genuine turn of phrase, standing in for abandoning strategy entirely in favour of enthusiasm. Play it before any reckless charge into a situation nobody has prepared for. At least, as he pointed out, he has chicken.
origin: From the legendary 2005 World of Warcraft raid video.
